entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding with VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Charlie. I'm... I'm a bit overwhelmed. I bought this helmet a while ago, and I need to return it. The box is unopened, I think. I just don't know what to do.
I can definitely help you look into that. Do you happen to have your order number?
Yes, I have it here. It's VF-98211. It's just... the color wasn't what I expected when I saw it through the plastic. The website was so confusing. Can't you just help me figure this out?

Of course, I'm happy to help. One moment while I pull up order VF-98211... Okay, I see it. This was for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 53 days ago. To make sure I understand, is the issue specifically with the color, or is there a technical fault with the item?
Oh no, there's nothing wrong with it. I'm sure all the safety features are perfectly fine. It's purely the color. I feel so silly about it.
Not at all, I completely understand. Let me just confirm our policy for you. Okay, good news. Since the helmet is a standard item, it falls within our 90-day return window.
It does? Oh, that's such a relief! I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Nope, you are well within the timeframe. I've just approved the return for you. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label. All you need to do is put that label on the box and drop it at a post office.
That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright, have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
